entities.summary: Ahmad Mohammad Bahar was a Palestinian politician who served as the first deputy speaker of the Palestinian Legislative Council (PLC) since his election to that post on 18 February 2006. Born in Gaza City, Palestine, he was a professor at the Islamic University of Gaza.
